machine.name: A brief with sources
machine.purpose: Compare three fictional note tools for one person who needs offline access and Markdown export. Every claim must point to the supplied source; missing facts remain unknown.

states.name: Set the decision criteria
states.description: Read sample/brief.md. Record the intended user, the two required features, and the supplied source scope.

qualityConditions.text: Single-user use, offline access, and Markdown export are recorded.

strategies.during: Use the host agent and record concise evidence in the task workspace.
strategies.onFailure: Record the concrete gap; do not mark it as passed.
strategies.onUncertain: Keep this state and ask for the missing information.

states.name: Read all three sources
states.description: Read the supplied files and extract facts into artifacts/source-notes.md. Treat them as fictional demo data, not real vendor claims.
